name: Anno Domini Beats
notes: Strong for hybrid electronic records with rap-adjacent energy.
whenToPitch: After final master; include BPM, key, and 2 comps.

name: DJ-focused imprints (open demos)
notes: Filter labels accepting club records 124–132 BPM.
whenToPitch: Week 3–4 of rollout with private link + DJ mix proof.

name: Boutique Techno labels
notes: Research 5 labels you actually play in sets; personalize heavily.
whenToPitch: Only after playlist traction or strong DJ support.

name: Netlabels & free-release imprints
notes: Good for building catalog momentum before bigger shops.
whenToPitch: Early in campaign for awareness, not revenue.

name: Remix / edit labels
notes: If you have a official remix or licensed edit, pitch with clearance notes.

name: Vocal feature imprints
notes: Include vocalist credit, split sheet status, and lyrics theme.
whenToPitch: After Spotify pre-save campaign shows traction.

name: Compilation curators
notes: VA comps are a foot in the door; read past tracklists first.

name: Your city collectives
notes: Local labels often sign artists they see play live — book shows first.
whenToPitch: After 2–3 local shows or live clips perform well.
